본문과 해석

원문 PASSAGE
1Ridge was a high school student who wanted to major in music in college. 2For weeks, on his balcony, every night he listened to a man playing the guitar in the apartment across the courtyard. 3Although the songs the man played were all new to Ridge, he somehow managed to attach his own made-up lyrics to them. 4One night, Ridge slid open the balcony door and stepped outside. 5He told his mom he was going out to the balcony to do his homework. 6The man was playing the guitar on his balcony as usual and Ridge started to mindlessly follow the rhythm. 7While Ridge was singing along to the music, the man suddenly stopped playing. 8He had never stopped in the middle of a song, so naturally Ridge looked in his direction. 9The man held up his index finger as if to say, "Hold on." 10He lifted one sheet of paper, and Ridge narrowed his eyes to get a good look at what was written on it. 11His phone number and "Text me" were written on the sheet. 12Then he flipped the paper over and wrote, "I have a question." 13Curious about the man's question, and wondering why he had asked for a text instead of a call, Ridge pulled out his phone and entered the number. 14He typed, "What's your question?" 15The man texted, "I want to know how you're singing lyrics to my songs when I haven't even added lyrics to them yet." 16Ridge was greatly surprised. 17Why hadn't he thought the man could see him sitting out there? 18He had never thought the man had noticed him singing along to his music. 19The man sent another message asking, "Will you send them to me?" 20After reading the man's message asking for his lyrics, Ridge hesitated. 21Ridge loved writing lyrics, but he had never shared anything he'd written with anyone. 22Eventually, he wrote down one of his favorite lyrics and sent it to him. 23A few days later, a new message came from the man. 24He wanted to use Ridge's lyrics for his new album. 25It turned out he was a deaf guitarist and songwriter in a band called Brennan's Band.
전체 해석
1Ridge는 대학에서 음악을 전공하고 싶어 하는 고등학생이었다. 2몇 주 동안 그는 매일 밤 자기 발코니에서, 안뜰 건너편 아파트에서 기타를 치는 한 남자의 연주를 들었다. 3그 남자가 연주하는 노래들은 Ridge에게 모두 처음 듣는 것이었지만, 그는 어찌어찌 자기가 지어낸 가사를 그 곡들에 붙였다. 4어느 날 밤, Ridge는 발코니 문을 밀어 열고 밖으로 나갔다. 5그는 엄마에게 숙제를 하러 발코니에 나간다고 말했다. 6그 남자는 여느 때처럼 자기 발코니에서 기타를 치고 있었고, Ridge는 무심코 그 리듬을 따라가기 시작했다. 7Ridge가 음악에 맞춰 노래를 따라 부르고 있는데, 그 남자가 갑자기 연주를 멈췄다. 8그는 노래 도중에 멈춘 적이 한 번도 없었기에, Ridge는 자연스럽게 그쪽을 바라보았다. 9그 남자는 "잠깐만"이라고 말하려는 듯 집게손가락을 들어 보였다. 10그는 종이 한 장을 들어 올렸고, Ridge는 거기에 무엇이 적혀 있는지 잘 보려고 눈을 가늘게 떴다. 11그 종이에는 그의 전화번호와 "문자 주세요"라고 적혀 있었다. 12그러고 나서 그는 종이를 뒤집어 "물어볼 게 있어요"라고 썼다. 13그 남자의 질문이 궁금했고, 왜 전화가 아니라 문자를 요청했는지 의아해하며, Ridge는 휴대전화를 꺼내 그 번호를 입력했다. 14그는 "무엇이 궁금하신가요?"라고 입력했다. 15그 남자는 "제가 아직 가사를 붙이지도 않은 제 노래에 당신이 어떻게 가사를 붙여 부르고 있는지 알고 싶어요."라고 문자를 보냈다. 16Ridge는 크게 놀랐다. 17왜 그는 그 남자가 자기가 밖에 앉아 있는 것을 볼 수 있다고 생각하지 못했을까? 18그는 그 남자가 자기가 음악에 맞춰 따라 부르는 것을 알아차렸으리라고는 한 번도 생각해 본 적이 없었다. 19그 남자는 "그것들을 저에게 보내 주시겠어요?"라고 묻는 또 하나의 메시지를 보냈다. 20가사를 보내 달라는 그 남자의 메시지를 읽고서 Ridge는 망설였다. 21Ridge는 가사 쓰기를 무척 좋아했지만, 자기가 쓴 것을 누구에게도 보여 준 적이 없었다. 22결국 그는 자신이 가장 아끼는 가사 중 하나를 적어 그에게 보냈다. 23며칠 뒤, 그 남자에게서 새로운 메시지가 왔다. 24그는 Ridge의 가사를 자신의 새 앨범에 쓰고 싶어 했다. 25알고 보니 그는 Brennan's Band라는 밴드의 청각장애가 있는 기타리스트이자 작곡가였다.

1.major in = specialize in
2.courtyard = inner yard
3.somehow = in some way
4.manage to = succeed in
5.attach = affix, append
반의어 ↔
1.major in ↔ —
2.courtyard ↔ —
3.somehow ↔ —
4.manage to ↔ fail to
5.attach ↔ detach, remove
영영풀이
1.courtyard: an open area surrounded by buildings or walls
2.lyrics: the words of a song
3.hesitate: to pause before doing something because of doubt
4.deaf: unable to hear
5.flip: to turn something over so the other side shows
필수 표현

1.
Ridge was a high school student who wanted to major in music in college.
2.
For weeks, on his balcony, every night he listened to a man playing the guitar in the apartment across the courtyard.
3.
Although the songs the man played were all new to Ridge, he somehow managed to attach his own made-up lyrics to them.
4.
One night, Ridge slid open the balcony door and stepped outside.
5.
He told his mom he was going out to the balcony to do his homework.
6.
The man was playing the guitar on his balcony as usual and Ridge started to mindlessly follow the rhythm.
7.
While Ridge was singing along to the music, the man suddenly stopped playing.
8.
He had never stopped in the middle of a song, so naturally Ridge looked in his direction.
9.
The man held up his index finger as if to say, "Hold on."
10.
He lifted one sheet of paper, and Ridge narrowed his eyes to get a good look at what was written on it.
11.
His phone number and "Text me" were written on the sheet.
12.
Then he flipped the paper over and wrote, "I have a question."
13.
Curious about the man's question, and wondering why he had asked for a text instead of a call, Ridge pulled out his phone and entered the number.
14.
He typed, "What's your question?"
15.
The man texted, "I want to know how you're singing lyrics to my songs when I haven't even added lyrics to them yet."
16.
Ridge was greatly surprised.
17.
Why hadn't he thought the man could see him sitting out there?
18.
He had never thought the man had noticed him singing along to his music.
19.
The man sent another message asking, "Will you send them to me?"
20.
After reading the man's message asking for his lyrics, Ridge hesitated.
21.
Ridge loved writing lyrics, but he had never shared anything he'd written with anyone.
22.
Eventually, he wrote down one of his favorite lyrics and sent it to him.
23.
A few days later, a new message came from the man.
24.
He wanted to use Ridge's lyrics for his new album.
25.
It turned out he was a deaf guitarist and songwriter in a band called Brennan's Band.

2
몇 주 동안 그는 매일 밤 자기 발코니에서, 안뜰 건너편 아파트에서 기타를 치는 한 남자의 연주를 들었다.
3
그 남자가 연주하는 노래들은 Ridge에게 모두 처음 듣는 것이었지만, 그는 어찌어찌 자기가 지어낸 가사를 그 곡들에 붙였다.
4
어느 날 밤, Ridge는 발코니 문을 밀어 열고 밖으로 나갔다.
5
그는 엄마에게 숙제를 하러 발코니에 나간다고 말했다.
6
그 남자는 여느 때처럼 자기 발코니에서 기타를 치고 있었고, Ridge는 무심코 그 리듬을 따라가기 시작했다.
7
Ridge가 음악에 맞춰 노래를 따라 부르고 있는데, 그 남자가 갑자기 연주를 멈췄다.
8
그는 노래 도중에 멈춘 적이 한 번도 없었기에, Ridge는 자연스럽게 그쪽을 바라보았다.
9
그 남자는 "잠깐만"이라고 말하려는 듯 집게손가락을 들어 보였다.
10
그는 종이 한 장을 들어 올렸고, Ridge는 거기에 무엇이 적혀 있는지 잘 보려고 눈을 가늘게 떴다.
11
그 종이에는 그의 전화번호와 "문자 주세요"라고 적혀 있었다.
12
그러고 나서 그는 종이를 뒤집어 "물어볼 게 있어요"라고 썼다.
13
그 남자의 질문이 궁금했고, 왜 전화가 아니라 문자를 요청했는지 의아해하며, Ridge는 휴대전화를 꺼내 그 번호를 입력했다.
14

15
그 남자는 "제가 아직 가사를 붙이지도 않은 제 노래에 당신이 어떻게 가사를 붙여 부르고 있는지 알고 싶어요."라고 문자를 보냈다.
16
Ridge는 크게 놀랐다.
17
왜 그는 그 남자가 자기가 밖에 앉아 있는 것을 볼 수 있다고 생각하지 못했을까?
18

20

STEP 7 통문장 영작 25문항
1
Ridge was a high school student who wanted to major in music in college.
2
For weeks, on his balcony, every night he listened to a man playing the guitar in the apartment across the courtyard.
3
Although the songs the man played were all new to Ridge, he somehow managed to attach his own made-up lyrics to them.
4
One night, Ridge slid open the balcony door and stepped outside.
5
He told his mom he was going out to the balcony to do his homework.
6
The man was playing the guitar on his balcony as usual and Ridge started to mindlessly follow the rhythm.
7
While Ridge was singing along to the music, the man suddenly stopped playing.
8
He had never stopped in the middle of a song, so naturally Ridge looked in his direction.
9
The man held up his index finger as if to say, "Hold on."
10
He lifted one sheet of paper, and Ridge narrowed his eyes to get a good look at what was written on it.
11
His phone number and "Text me" were written on the sheet.
12
Then he flipped the paper over and wrote, "I have a question."
13
Curious about the man's question, and wondering why he had asked for a text instead of a call, Ridge pulled out his phone and entered the number.
14
He typed, "What's your question?"
15
The man texted, "I want to know how you're singing lyrics to my songs when I haven't even added lyrics to them yet."
16
Ridge was greatly surprised.
17
Why hadn't he thought the man could see him sitting out there?
18
He had never thought the man had noticed him singing along to his music.
19
The man sent another message asking, "Will you send them to me?"
20
After reading the man's message asking for his lyrics, Ridge hesitated.
21
Ridge loved writing lyrics, but he had never shared anything he'd written with anyone.
22
Eventually, he wrote down one of his favorite lyrics and sent it to him.
23
A few days later, a new message came from the man.
24
He wanted to use Ridge's lyrics for his new album.
25
It turned out he was a deaf guitarist and songwriter in a band called Brennan's Band.
